verdict.rationale: Metronome supports several rule-based automations that execute without manual intervention — webhooks firing on events like contract creation/threshold breaches (docs-4), auto-recharge of prepaid credits when balances run out (docs-14), automatic Stripe invoice generation (docs-5, docs-18), scheduled subscription/seat changes (docs-31), and automatic contract provisioning for self-serve signups (docs-25). These are background automations tied to billing events, but there's no evidence of a general-purpose automation/workflow builder or AI-agent-style autonomous task execution that an 'ai-native' user could configure freely. Missing for 10: a flexible automation/rules engine beyond fixed billing triggers, evidence of AI/agent-driven decisioning, and independent confirmation these automations run reliably unattended in production.
